title: 实现 Career 职级系统
constraints: Use real Codex Luna Developer and Codex Sol Reviewer; never use Mock.
Do not implement Phase 3 or prohibited systems such as real ads, backend, friends, rankings, store, skins, payments or cloud saves.
Do not claim Cocos Editor validation unless the Editor is actually launched.
All state changes must go through services and critical save failures must not leave memory ahead of persistence.
goal: 实现前 10 职级配置与 CareerService，严格分离 worker.level 和 player.careerLevel。
background: Phase 2 sequential task TASK-022; depends on TASK-021 being DONE, except TASK-020 which depends on Phase 1.1 PASS.
requirements: 10 个职级名称、境界、requiredExp 配置驱动。
Worker Level 与 Career Level 无字段复用或隐式同步。
